metadata.title: About
metadata.description: Learn about Forge Studio, our principles, and how we approach software engineering for businesses.

intro.title: Independent by design. Serious about the outcome.
intro.description: Forge Studio is an independent software studio focused on designing and engineering reliable digital products for businesses.

reliability.title: Reliability above all
reliability.description: Software should be stable, secure, and predictable in the moments your business depends on it.

businessFirst.title: Business-first approach
businessFirst.description: Technology is a tool. Every decision should connect back to a clear operational or commercial outcome.

precision.title: Precision engineering
precision.description: We value clean systems, careful details, and simple solutions over convoluted, trendy ones.

studio.title: Small enough to stay close to the work.
studio.paragraph1: Forge Studio is built around a simple idea: businesses need software partners who listen carefully, communicate plainly, and take responsibility for what gets shipped. We work independently, keep the team focused, and make the path from idea to production visible.
studio.paragraph2: That means no unnecessary layers, no technical theatre, and no handoff before the system is ready to be useful.
